WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO prompt_versions (
                prompt_id,
                version,
                stage,
                content,
                metadata,
                created_by
            ) VALUES (
                $1,
                $2,
                ($3::text)::prompt_stage,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                prompt_id,
                version,
                stage::text AS stage,
                content,
                metadata,
                created_by,
                created_at
         )
         SELECT
            i.id AS "id!",
            i.prompt_id AS "prompt_id!",
            i.version AS "version!",
            i.stage AS "stage!",
            i.content AS "content!",
            i.metadata,
            i.created_by AS "created_by!",
            u.email AS created_by_email,
            i.created_at AS "created_at!"
         FROM inserted i
         LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = i.created_by
